contracts: One explicit owned new resume can supersede a confirmed earlier correction: 2028 -> 2033 -> 2030. Fact identity is stable; each actual update adds one version/audit entry with the previous active value.

A unique explicit source outranks historical embedded resume labels. Missing, conflicting, multi-date or ambiguously targeted explicit sources cause no mutation and never fall back to historical labels.
Repeated current source delivery is a no-op; identical previously adopted and superseded source bytes cannot replay an earlier correction. Freshness is not inferred from numeric graduation year.
Active resolution annotations reflect only the latest selected value; prior values stay in the audit and cannot become current again through legacy APIs.
Quoted, hypothetical or conditional text is not a direct correction instruction.
Exact staged handler keeps repeated corrections atomic, owner-scoped and stable-key replayable. Failed saves and foreign/default-ID collisions cannot transfer source authority or corrected values.
No new persistence system, migration, credential, paid provider call or browser task.
